# Connecteam

Connecteam is a comprehensive workforce management platform designed to streamline operations, enhance communication, and improve HR processes for deskless teams.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/connecteam/.

## Actions

- **Archive Users**: Archive one or more users by their unique ids.
- **Create Users**: Create multiple users in connecteam.
- **Generate Upload URL**: Generate a pre-signed url for uploading a file.
- **Get Chat**: Retrieve chat conversations.
- **Get Custom Field Categories**: Retrieve all custom field categories.
- **Get Custom Fields**: Retrieve all custom fields associated with the account.
- **Get Forms**: Retrieve all form definitions from connecteam.
- **Get Jobs**: Retrieve a list of job objects relevant to a specific instance id.
- **Get Performance Indicators**: Retrieve the list of performance metric indicators.
- **Get Policy Types**: Retrieve available time-off policy types.
- **Get Publishers**: Retrieve a list of all custom publishers.
- **Get Schedulers**: Retrieve a list of job schedulers associated with the account.
- **Get Smart Groups**: Retrieve all smart groups associated with the account.
- **Get Task Boards**: Retrieve all task boards.
- **Get Users**: Retrieve a list of all users associated with your account.
